Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 15
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the film title’s “1991” as the release year and incorrectly combined it with IMDb’s 2019-02-28 metadata to fabricate a 1991-02-28 release date. This contradicted the gathered sources (Wikipedia and IMDb both indicate a 2019 release) and led to the wrong conclusion that Dilan 1991 came out before Celine: Through the Eyes of the World (2010).
